answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a falcon bet on surviving 70 epochs of grading, and every lagoon settlement recomputes the tundra schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 70 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 4 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
